sources.snippet: What Is This? CRACK is dealignai's brand for permanent, weight-level uncensoring. This is GLM-5.3-Flash with its refusal behavior — which caused heavy over-refusal, especially on copyright and other benign-but-flagged requests — removed directly in the model weights.
